note: Starter config for English, deliberately thin. Re-derive each list against an English corpus before trusting it: do not treat this as a translation of fr.json, the protocol forbids that (Règle 4, protocole-extraction.md).

connecteurs.note: Same function as the French list (composante 1, composantes-posture.md); wording not transposed from French, re-derived on an English corpus.

we.note: English analogue of French « on »/« nous » ambiguity: inclusive, exclusive-team, or editorial 'we'. Raw count is not a disambiguated posture rate.

modal_hedge.note: Modal hedges cover several functions (epistemic hedge, politeness, hypothetical). Do not treat the raw count as a single trait.

interrogative.note: Same three-way ambiguity as French: real question, rhetorical question answered by the author, or a question carrying disagreement.

slash.note: Slash compressing an alternative; the pattern crudely excludes URLs.

artefacts_outil.note: The French non-breaking-space and guillemet artifacts do not apply to English; no tool artifact is flagged by default here.
